name: Relocate, financing the purchase instead of paying cash
description: The same relocation, but the 2032 purchase is financed: 20% down (so no PMI), 30-year mortgage at 6.5%, and the sale proceeds the down payment does not consume are invested per the allocation rather than sunk into the house. The comparison against relocate-lower-tax is the real question — a mortgage keeps money invested and adds a fixed nominal payment, and which wins depends on the return the plan assumes.
